responsibility: Implements the AVR target’s C-front-end integration that cannot live in the generic backend file because it depends on C-family facilities. Its main responsibility is target builtin handling at the language level: it resolves overloaded AVR fixed-point builtins such as `absfx`, `roundfx`, and related families to the concrete machine builtin declarations based on argument count and type modes, emits target-specific diagnostics for mismatches, and defines the AVR preprocessor environment by publishing `__AVR_*` architecture, memory-model, library-configuration, address-space, and builtin-availability macros consumed by user code and AVR-LibC headers.
